mentions.name: Media Bias News Search Prototype
mentions.description: A prototype search tool for retrieving news from multiple media outlets, meant to help readers see coverage across different sources and counter heavy political polarization driven by outlets that cherry-pick and distort events. Accompanied by a draft article (originally written for churches) describing how media bias affects individuals and institutions and recommending solutions.
mentions.problem: Heavy polarization of Americans, individually and even in churches, driven by media outlets that cherry-pick and lie, with Left and Right reporting the same events so differently that their readers might as well live in different worlds.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recommend solutions which include AllSides.com (amazing!) and search engines for retrieving news from multiple outlets. I have a prototype. Progress is slow on my tool because I work two jobs with my free time mostly going to ministry serving Christ and others.

https://heswithjesus.com/mediabias.html
